scripts.e2e:live-with-k6: sh -c 'TS=$(date +%s); LOG_DIR=${LOG_DIR:-.generated/live-runner}; mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"; K6_LOG_FILE=${K6_LOG_FILE:-$LOG_DIR/k6-$TS.log}; LIVE_RUN_LOG_FILE=${LIVE_RUN_LOG_FILE:-$LOG_DIR/live-runner-$TS.log}; echo "[combo] k6 log: $K6_LOG_FILE"; echo "[combo] live log: $LIVE_RUN_LOG_FILE"; k6 run "${K6_SCRIPT:-k6/prod-start-exam-200.js}" > "$K6_LOG_FILE" 2>&1 & K6_PID=$!; LIVE_RUN_LOG_FILE="$LIVE_RUN_LOG_FILE" npm run e2e:live-runner; STATUS=$?; kill $K6_PID >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait $K6_PID >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit $STATUS'
